skill.name: Youtube and Bilibili Subtitle Extraction and Summary

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
Extract subtitles from YouTube or Bilibili, save raw transcript, and generate a structured summary. Triggers: ANY URL containing youtube.com, youtu.be, bilib...

latestVersion.changelog:
youtube-summary v1.0.0

- Initial release: Extracts subtitles from YouTube and Bilibili URLs or via key phrases.
- Supports authentication for Bilibili subtitle downloads using browser cookies.
- Cleans and saves the raw transcript in a structured Markdown file with video metadata.
- Generates a summary from the transcript, using map-reduce for long videos.
- Triggers automatically on video URLs or requests like "summarize this video" and similar phrases.
